chunks: Abdul Wahid ibn Abdullah narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Qurashi narrated to us, he said: He narrated to me Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Qutayba al-A'sha, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:
When the banner of the truth is raised, the people of the East and the West will curse it. I said to him: 'From what is that?' He said: 'From what they receive from the Banu Hashim.'

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ: People of the East and the West
key_terms.بَنُو هَاشِمٍ: Banu Hashim (the clan of the Prophet and Imams)

ai.seo_question: Why will the people of the East and West curse the banner of truth when it is raised?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (as) explains that the widespread cursing of the banner of truth by the East and West stems from the accumulated grievances and afflictions inflicted upon the Banu Hashim during the occultation period. This highlights the political and social alienation of the Ahl al-Bayt as a primary catalyst for the global reception of the Mahdi. The narration underscores the continuity of persecution from the Umayyad and Abbasid eras into the era of the Qa'im.
